svg.title: Spotwhere: where to go in Moscow, found by the place you name
svg.desc: Banner of Spotwhere, a Telegram Mini App. On the left the SPOTWHERE logo, the tagline "The evening begins with one message" and three features: search near a metro station, district, landmark or you; rules first, the language model only picks from a shortlist; 12.6 thousand real places in Moscow. On the right the app itself: the query "бар у метро Тверская" with the Near me button, the line "Near metro Тверская, within 800 m" and a swipe card for the bar "Молодость", 60 metres away, about 1500 rubles.
